page.layout: One printed title page, all lines centred, in reading order from top to bottom.
page.notes: Pencilled handwriting in the upper right (a shelfmark or ownership note) is not transcribed. Faint show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed. The printed "VV" in "PER VVOLFGANGVM" is kept as printed, since it stands for W. The vowel u in GANGVM, MVSCVLVM and DVSANVM is normalised to u as the rules require, and the long s in "Apostoli" and "Ephesios" is written as s. The final "VM" and "VM." are normalised to UM and UM. in the output.
